verses.pali: “Pañcahi, anuruddha, dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
Assaddho ca hoti, ahiriko ca hoti, anottappī ca hoti, maccharī ca hoti, duppañño ca hoti—
verses.english: “… They’re faithless, shameless, imprudent, stingy, and witless. …”

verses.pali: imehi kho, anuruddha, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo …pe…
